description: Residuos Sólidos Urbanos is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Ambiente. Muestra la generación, disposición, composición y distribución de los residuos sólidos urbanos por jurisdicción en los períodos considerados. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Ambiente. Its tags are ODS, Solidos urbanos. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
